name: Image block
purpose: A media block using real figure/figcaption semantics: an image area plus an optional caption and an optional attribution line, with aspect-ratio variants on the 4px grid and a loading/skeleton state borrowed verbatim from Skeleton-loader. PROPOSED at #210 wave-4 lane C; not registered, not ruled.

props.name: aspectRatio
props.$note: Declared once on .media via the CSS aspect-ratio property — a ratio, not a pixel value; the 4px grid discipline is enforced on every SURROUNDING measurement (figcaption padding 12/16, gap 4, line heights) rather than on the ratio itself.

props.name: caption
props.$note: Optional. When present, renders as the first paragraph inside <figcaption>, bound to .t-cm-caption.

props.name: attribution
props.$note: Optional, independent of caption. Renders as a second paragraph inside the SAME <figcaption> (not a sibling landmark) so one AT pass reads both, bound to .t-cm-legal.

props.name: state
props.$note: loading borrows Skeleton-loader's .bone atom + token pair verbatim. broken swaps the media area for the byte-matched informative/broken-image.svg glyph, centred, no invented icon.

tokens.font-family: n/a for the media area; captions use .t-cm-caption, attribution uses .t-cm-legal
tokens.media: tertiary/background/hover as the placeholder fill (--ph-fill), form/border/default as the diagonal corner-mark stroke (--ph-mark) — the same bone pair Skeleton-loader already uses for its media bone, deliberately kept in sync
tokens.shell: border/subtle + border-radius/surface for the figure's own shell, matching Cards' surface discipline
tokens.$contrast: No contrast pair declared for the placeholder fill itself (decorative, role=img with a real aria-label carries the meaning, not the pixels) — captions and attribution both declare pairs against the surface.

motion.shimmer: Loading state's shimmer is Skeleton-loader's own keyframe, byte-identical (background-position sweep, 1.4s linear infinite).
motion.reducedMotion: Shimmer and gradient removed under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce — static bone, shape alone carries the loading read (2.3.3), same as Skeleton-loader.

responsive.rule: Width is the container's — no fixed max-width baked into .imgblock; aspect-ratio keeps the media area proportional at any container width with zero JS.

livesInside: Cards (the media card's .img area is a candidate consumer)
Carousel (each slide's picture area is this component's media anatomy)
mustNotNeighbour: Skeleton-loader's own generic media bone for the SAME region (one loading signal per region, same rule Skeleton-loader states for itself)
triggeredBy: any real photograph, illustration or diagram that needs a caption or credit line

accessibility.role: The placeholder , same alt-text discipline. The loading region carries role="status" + aria-busy="true" + a visually-hidden 'Loading image', identical wiring to Skeleton-loader.
accessibility.name: figcaption is the native accessible association for the caption/attribution pair — no aria-labelledby needed.
accessibility.keyboard: Nothing focusable in the static states; a real would not be focusable either. If the block becomes a link (e.g. inside a media card), the LINK carries the interaction, not this component.
accessibility.focus: n/a — no interactive elements at this layer.
accessibility.nonText: Placeholder rectangles are decorative pattern-fills; the aria-label is what carries meaning to AT, and 1.4.11 does not apply to the fill itself for the same reason it does not apply to Skeleton-loader's bones.
relatedSC: 1.4.11 Non-text Contrast (exempt for the decorative fill)

antiPatterns: Real or fake photography standing in for the placeholder — SVG rect placeholders only, per the wave-4 DO-NOT-RULE
A second, differently-styled placeholder mechanism instead of reusing Skeleton-loader's bone atom
An attribution line with no visible caption above it and no aria-label explaining the credit's subject
A drawn broken-image glyph instead of the byte-matched informative/broken-image.svg
Cropping via object-fit without ever declaring aspect-ratio, so the layout jumps when the real asset arrives

tokenValidation.result: PASS — bound vars match resolved light+dark; re-verify via _validate_binds_resolve.py per the receipt's claim table (check-D canon-block failure is DECLARED, same class every unregistered wave-4 snippet carries).
tokenValidation.$note: Built wave 4, lane C (Sonnet), #210. Loading state deliberately shares Skeleton-loader's token pair rather than minting a parallel one.

usedInContext.$note: Cards (the media card's .img area is a candidate consumer)
Carousel (each slide's picture area is this component's media anatomy)
